note: Authoritative multi-seed and 10-fold summary. All AP values are percentages. Training seeds are independent of data-split seeds; every M3FD-LT20 run uses the fixed lt20_seed42 split.

vedai_10fold_rscdetr.protocol: Official VEDAI folds 1-10; each fold's val_dataloader points at that fold's held-out test annotation; best-epoch AP. Fold 1 is the batch-4 re-evaluation of the released checkpoint.

vedai_10fold_baseline.protocol: RT-DETR concat baseline, same official folds and best-epoch rule.
vedai_10fold_baseline.note: Separate ten-fold repeat of the concat config; fold-1 AP 56.71, not the main-table concat run (57.53). The paired comparison measures run-to-run variability under a common protocol.

vedai.protocol: Best checkpoint per training seed; val_dataloader is the fold-1 test annotation; batch 4. Seed-3407 value is the released-checkpoint re-evaluation.

m3fd.protocol: Uniform clean re-evaluation of each best checkpoint with tools/eval_per_class_test.py, batch 8, instances_test.json; all three training seeds use the same fixed split.

dvtod.protocol: Best validation checkpoint per training seed.

m3fd_old_values.reason: The 42/3407/2024 values mix the batch-4 headline re-evaluation with per-run training-log test_set_stats at the final epoch. They are not a uniform best-checkpoint comparison and are superseded by the batch-8 clean re-evaluation above. The seed-42 55.897 remains the manuscript headline (55.90) and is valid for the final 419-pair test set.
